_comment: Hand-authored GATE 1 answer key for STAGING.ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS. Authored from the checked-in artifacts only (scripts/run_daily_orders.ksh, psets/pset_templates/orders_staging.pset, dml/order_items.dml, graphs/cdc_processor.py, data/sample/orders.dat). Keys prefixed with '_' are ignored by the verifier. Never edited by an analysis run.
formula: direct carry, no transformation: ORDER_SYSTEM.ORDERS.STATUS -> raw_orders.status (extract_orders) -> orders_delta.status (cdc_orders, hash-compare) -> order_items.order_status (DML bind in load_staging_orders) -> STAGING.ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS (LOAD_MODE=MERGE)

nodes._why: Phase 1 of run_daily_orders.ksh runs graphs/orders/extract_orders.mp with orders_extract.pset; neither is in the repo. RECORD_SOURCE=ORDER_SYSTEM comes from orders_staging.pset. Raw shape is data/sample/orders.dat: 7 pipe-delimited columns, no header, column 4 holds SHIPPED/DELIVERED/PROCESSING.

hops._why: Phase 2 runs graphs/orders/cdc_orders.mp (missing) with orders_cdc.pset (missing). graphs/cdc_processor.py is the execution pattern: CDCProcessor(key_columns, compare_columns) MD5-hashes compare columns and emits inserts/updates/deletes. Value is carried unchanged; row visibility depends on compare_columns. SOURCE_PATH=/data/cdc/orders/delta in orders_staging.pset confirms a CDC delta feeds the next step.
orders_staging.pset: DML_FILE=/data/projects/enterprise_etl/dml/order_items.dml. dml/order_items.dml last field is string("\n") order_status. This is the only explicit DML binding in the estate.
orders_staging.pset: TARGET_TABLE=STAGING.ORDERS, TARGET_SCHEMA=STAGING, LOAD_MODE=MERGE, REJECT_PATH=/data/rejects/orders, MAX_ERRORS=100. Merge key order_id is inferred (first DML field, CDC key).

downstream_consumers: prod_rollover_orders (Phase 4, orders_prod.pset missing) - reads STAGING.ORDERS, not part of the upstream chain
expected_findings: F-PSET: orders_extract.pset, orders_cdc.pset, orders_prod.pset not in repo; orders_pipeline.pset present but unreferenced
F-DML-1: order_items.dml (5 fields, two item_count vectors, comma-delimited) does not match data/sample/orders.dat (7 flat pipe-delimited columns)
F-WRAP-1: run_daily_orders.ksh uses '| tee' without 'set -o pipefail', so a failed phase can exit 0
